content:
Although BPMN is an extensive standard, it allows for some vendor specific implementation choices and details. This section and the sections below will describe the supported BPMN concepts and element and how these are implemented by the TaktX engine. 

The BPMN sections are divided like a class-tree, with real abstract FlowNodeInstance on top and a tree of subclasses. Each subclass adds a specific set of behaviour to the parent class. 

Some of the concepts and implementation details overarch the specific BPMN classes. These concepts are described in separate sections. These concepts include things like:

  • Error and escalation handling
  • FEEL Expression handling
  • Variable scope handling
